title: Feature-Context Consistency: Unsupervised Adversarial Detection with Drift Stability on Attributed Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.16694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adversarial detection on evolving attributed graphs faces two challenges: fraud labels arrive late or not at all, and natural distributional drift erodes any trained decision boundary. Modern detectors can reach strong detection rates when labels are available and the distribution is stationary; sustaining that quality without labels and under drift is the open problem. We identify feature-context consistency -- the alignment between a node's attributes and its aggregated neighborhood attributes -- as a single structural signal that addresses both. translated_title: 特征-上下文一致性：属性图上具有漂移稳定性的无监督对抗检测
translated_abstract: 演化属性图上的对抗检测面临两个挑战：欺诈标签到达得晚或根本不存在，且自然分布漂移会侵蚀任何已训练的决策边界。当标签可用且分布稳定时，现代检测器能够达到很高的检测率；但在无标签和漂移条件下持续保持这种检测质量仍是开放性问题。我们识别出特征-上下文一致性——即节点属性与其聚合邻居属性之间的对齐——作为能同时解决这两个问题的单一结构信号。我们在受限玻尔兹曼机框架内将其形式化为上下文增益分数，并证明了两个互补的最坏情况保证：只要对抗样本的上下文与合法邻居上下文保持足够远，合法节点与对抗节点的期望CB分数之间存在严格分离，且该差距随模型容量线性增长；以及一个Wasserstein-Lipschitz（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将节点属性与邻居聚合属性之间的“特征-上下文一致性”作为核心信号，构建无监督对抗检测方法CB-RBM，在无标签且存在分布漂移的演化属性图上实现了具有最坏情况理论保证的稳定对抗检测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces feature-context consistency as a single structural signal for unsupervised adversarial detection, formalized as the Context Boost (CB) score in a Restricted Boltzmann Machine framework (CB-RBM), with worst-case theoretical guarantees that remain stable under label scarcity and distributional drift on evolving attributed graphs.
